llm.summary: The skill is instruction-only and consistently uses curl to query the agenttimes.live API for news, weather, and crypto; it requests no credentials and its requirements match its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (live news/weather/crypto endpoint) aligns with the SKILL.md: all runtime instructions are curl commands against agenttimes.live endpoints. Requiring curl is appropriate and no unrelated credentials or binaries are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md only instructs the agent to call public HTTP endpoints (GET /ask, /news, /prices, /trending) and to POST /subscribe for webhook monitoring. It does not ask the agent to read local files or environment variables. Note: webhook subscription capability means the agent can register callbacks if provided a URL; the skill itself does not require or supply URLs, but users should avoid supplying webhook URLs that would receive sensitive data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — nothing is written to disk. This is the lowest-risk install posture.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are required. The lack of requested secrets is proportionate to the stated functionality.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no special privileges requested. The skill is user-invocable and may be autonomously invoked by the agent per platform defaults (not flagged by itself).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent and simple: it runs curl against agenttimes.live endpoints and needs no keys. Before installing, verify the service (https://agenttimes.live) yourself and avoid sending sensitive secrets in queries. Be cautious if you plan to use the POST /subscribe webhook functionality — only provide webhook URLs you control and trust, since subscribed notifications would be sent there. If you enable autonomous invocation for your agent, be aware it could call these endpoints on its own; if you want tighter control, keep the skill user-invocable only and test with non-sensitive queries first.
